title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: restart

thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 2 discussion

opinions.point: Some commenters enjoyed the ending theme’s presentation and praised the vocal performance and character portrayals.
A few viewers found the series’ darker premise and strategic elements engaging.
Several commenters were interested in the characters but wished the discussion and characterization had more room to develop.
Some viewers found the episode difficult to enjoy and felt the premise has become less fresh compared with similar battle-royale anime.
A few commenters remained hesitant about continuing because they disliked the previous season or found the overall direction unpleasant.
